text_block_list.text:
While visiting Bubblyland, I see Winning
Ticket
tending to someone.

Are you okay?! You must have twisted
your ankle!
Hold onto my shoulders!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: Yowch! Geez Louise, that smarts!
You poor thing! I'll go call the park staff!
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
No way! I'm about to go on stage! They
won't let
me dance if they find out I'm
hurt!

Wait, are you... You're the star of
Bubblyland,
Fuzzy Buddy, right?!
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text: Yes. It is I, Fuzzy Buddy, star to kiddos everywhere. Even if I have to sacrifice my feet and my Friday night, I will stand on that stage and bring a smile to their faces!
text_block_list.name: Fuzzy Buddy
choice_data_list: You're seriously planning to dance in this state?

text_block_list.text:
...Uwaaaagh! That's such a cool way to
liiive!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
It takes a lot of guts to sacrifice your
legs!
Entertainment must really mean the
world to
you... You're such a bright,
sparkly staaarrr!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
I gotta help you! How about I stand in
for you?!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
Let me help too! You always put on such
great
shows for us, Fuzzy Buddy. Now
we can do
something for you! ♪
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
But you're totally unprepared! I can't let
you two
go up on that stage like this!
text_block_list.name: Fuzzy Buddy

text_block_list.text:
Please! We'll make sure the show's
spectacular!
We won't let you down!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
Th-those eyes! They're burning with true
bubbly
fire! ...All right. I believe in you
two!
text_block_list.name: Fuzzy Buddy

text_block_list.text: Tonight's show is up to you guys!
text_block_list.name: Fuzzy Buddy

text_block_list.text:
Having taken Fuzzy Buddy to the
infirmary, we
head back to the stage
where we can already hear
lively music.
It sounds like the show is starting!

YAAAY! Hey, everyone! Tonight we've
got
something extra special for all of
you!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
Woohoo! Let that fever rock your whole
body!
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text: Huh? Where's Fuzzy Buddy?
text_block_list.name: Audience

text_block_list.text:
Nighttime Bubblyland starts now! Let's
get things
bubbly!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
BOOO! You call that dancing?!/nGet
Fuzzy
Buddy out here already!
text_block_list.name: Audience

text_block_list.text:
Oh my... What a tough crowd. This is
rough!
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
Regroup, Maruzen! As you'd say, it's
time to
boogie-woogie!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: Wahooo! Are y'all feeling it?! My engine's going full throttle!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
Are they seriously going to dance all
night?
They're gonna regret that in the
morning!
text_block_list.name: Audience

text_block_list.text:
The two desperate dancers go nonstop
for over
an hour, and the audience starts
to see them in a
new light!

Ahaha! This is so fun! Come on,
everyone! Get
louder! Give in to the
FEVER!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
Who cares about time? We're back in
the bubble
era now!/nBack in time, back
in style!
text_block_list.name: Audience

text_block_list.text: It's working, Tickezo! They're all in sync!
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
We're just getting warmed up! Let's go,
everyone!
Get it MOVING!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: BOOOYAAAAH!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: Splaaash!

Уиннинг Тикит performs a flip in midair,
before
diving into the pool with
acrobatic flair!
WOOHOOO!/nRock our socks off!
text_block_list.name: Audience

text_block_list.text:
The spectators start diving in one after
another! It
looks like Уиннинг Тикит's
enthusiasm has caught
hold of them!

Hehe! They're totally into it! Looks like
they all
wanna make the most of their
time here!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
Check you out, thinking of the fans!
You're
practically a star yourself! ♪
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
If they wish hard enough for it, anyone
can be
whoever they wanna be! I'm so
happy I got to
show that to them!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
With their improvised show, Winning
Ticket and
Марузенски bring more fun
to Bubblyland than
it's ever known!
